description: This file is a makefile fragment for building Linux kernel modules within the OpenWrt build system. It contains variable definitions, conditional includes, and functions related to kernel configuration, compilation, and module handling.

methods.name: collect_module_symvers
methods.description: Collects and merges module symbol version files into a single Module.symvers file.

methods.name: KernelPackage
methods.description: Defines a kernel package with configuration, dependencies, and installation procedures.

methods.name: KernelPackage/Defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for kernel package parameters.

methods.name: KernelPackage/hooks
methods.description: Defines hooks for post-processing during kernel module compilation.

methods.name: KernelPackage/depends
methods.description: Defines dependencies for the kernel package based on configuration.

methods.name: ModuleAutoLoad
methods.description: Automatically generates module load and boot scripts based on module list and parameters.

methods.name: AutoLoad
methods.description: Creates auto-load configuration entries for modules.

methods.name: AutoProbe
methods.description: Creates auto-probe configuration entries for modules.

methods.name: version_filter
methods.description: Filters module version information based on metadata.
